selection_process: The PSSSB Junior Engineer selection process includes an objective-type written examination followed by counselling and document verification for candidates considered in accordance with the merit list and vacancy availability.

Written Examination: Candidates will appear in an objective-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ) examination. Merit List: Merit will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination. Counselling and Verification: Candidates called for counselling must produce valid original documents supporting their eligibility. Departmental Recommendation: Eligible candidates may be recommended to the concerned departments according to the common merit list and available vacancies.
Appearing in the examination or having a name in the merit list does not automatically guarantee appointment. Candidates must satisfy all required recruitment conditions.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications through the official PSSSB website during the reopened application period of 12 October to 27 October 2026.
Visit the official website: Open sssb.punjab.gov.in.
Open Apply Online: Select the recruitment application link for Advertisement No. 07/2026.
Register: New applicants without a User ID should select Registration and enter the required details to generate their login credentials.
Login: Sign in using the registered email address as User ID and the generated password.
Select Apply for Service: Open the application process and select the relevant Junior Engineer discipline according to your qualification.
Fill Personal and Educational Details: Enter the requested information carefully, including the applicable category and category code.
Upload Photograph and Signature: Upload the required passport-size photograph or use the live photograph capture facility where provided, along with the scanned signature.
Upload Documents: Use the Attach Annexure option to upload the Class 10 certificate, educational/technical qualification certificates and other required documents.
Save Documents: Complete the document upload process through the prescribed option.
Make Payment: Pay the applicable application fee online.
Submit Application: Complete final submission after successful payment.
Save the Form: Download or print the completed application form for future reference.

Important: The application will be accepted only after successful payment of the prescribed fee. Candidates should carefully review their entries because the advertisement does not permit corrections after final submission.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Latest News: What Has Changed?
content_sections.text: Application Reopened: Eligible candidates can apply online between 12 October and 27 October 2026. Exam Postponed: The written examination scheduled for 18 October 2026 has been postponed until further notice. Existing Applications Remain Valid: Candidates who have already applied are not required to submit another application. The Board has stated that the revised examination information will be published separately through a public notice on its official website.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB JE Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

content_sections.heading: Why Has PSSSB Reopened the Junior Engineer Application Form?
content_sections.text: PSSSB has reopened the application window in compliance with an interim order dated 8 October 2026 passed by the Punjab and Haryana High Court in CWP No. 32342 of 2026, Manveer Singh vs State of Punjab and Others. Under the public notice, eligible candidates are being provided an additional opportunity to apply for Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical and Electrical) Group-B posts.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Junior Engineer Posts 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment covers the following Junior Engineer disciplines:

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Junior Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the required educational or technical qualification for the Junior Engineer discipline selected in the application form. Candidates should possess a three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution. Candidates with a higher qualification in the same discipline from a recognized university or institution are also eligible under the qualification condition. Candidates should possess a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution. A higher qualification in the same engineering discipline is also accepted under the prescribed requirement. Candidates should possess a three-year Diploma in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution. Candidates holding a higher qualification in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution may also meet the educational qualification condition.

content_sections.heading: Can B.Tech Graduates Apply for PSSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Yes, candidates with a higher qualification in the same engineering discipline can satisfy the educational qualification requirement. For example, a candidate holding a recognized B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering may meet the qualification requirement for Junior Engineer (Civil). Similarly, candidates with recognized higher qualifications in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering may meet the relevant discipline requirement. Applicants must also satisfy the applicable age, Punjabi-language and other recruitment conditions. A higher qualification in an unrelated discipline does not automatically establish eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Is Punjabi Language Compulsory for PSSSB Junior Engineer?
content_sections.text: Yes. Under the Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994, candidates must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject, or an equivalent Punjabi-language examination recognized under the applicable Government rules. Applicants should verify their Punjabi-language qualification before proceeding with the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Junior Engineer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age criteria are calculated as on 1 January 2026.

content_sections.heading: Can Candidates from Other States Apply for PSSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates from other states should not assume that Punjab-specific reserved-category benefits apply to them. They must also satisfy the relevant educational, Punjabi-language, age and other eligibility requirements.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB JE Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The PSSSB Junior Engineer selection process includes an objective-type written examination followed by counselling and document verification for candidates considered in accordance with the merit list and vacancy availability. Written Examination: Candidates will appear in an objective-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ) examination. Merit List: Merit will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination. Counselling and Verification: Candidates called for counselling must produce valid original documents supporting their eligibility. Departmental Recommendation: Eligible candidates may be recommended to the concerned departments according to the common merit list and available vacancies. Appearing in the examination or having a name in the merit list does not automatically guarantee appointment. Candidates must satisfy all required recruitment conditions.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB JE Exam Date 2026: Is the 18 October Examination Postponed?
content_sections.text: Yes. PSSSB has officially postponed the Junior Engineer written examination that was scheduled for 18 October 2026. The public notice dated 9 October 2026 states that the examination is postponed until further notice. A revised examination date will be announced separately through the Board's official website. Candidates should monitor sssb.punjab.gov.in for the new examination date, syllabus, examination pattern, admit card and other updates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for PSSSB Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications through the official PSSSB website during the reopened application period of 12 October to 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Do Candidates Who Applied Earlier Need to Apply Again?
content_sections.text: The reopened application window provides another opportunity for eligible candidates to submit applications. Previously applied candidates should continue monitoring the official website for examination and recruitment updates.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for PSSSB Junior Engineer Application
content_sections.text: Candidates should prepare the relevant documents specified in the application instructions before completing the form. Class 10 certificate Relevant Engineering Diploma or higher-qualification certificates Passport-size photograph Scanned signature Category certificate, if claiming applicable reservation Punjab residence/domicile certificate, where required Relevant supporting certificates for age relaxation or other claimed benefits Original certificates must be produced during counselling or verification whenever required by the Board.

content_sections.heading: Can I Edit the PSSSB Junior Engineer Application After Submission?
content_sections.text: Before submitting the form, carefully check the selected post, educational details, name, category, category code, photograph, signature and uploaded documents.

faq.question: Q1. Has PSSSB JE Recruitment 2026 been reopened?
faq.answer: Yes. PSSSB has announced that eligible candidates can apply online again from 12 October to 27 October 2026 under Advertisement No. 07/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the new last date for PSSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The revised last date for online applications and fee payment is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is the PSSSB JE exam on 18 October 2026 postponed?
faq.answer: Yes. The 18 October 2026 Junior Engineer examination has been postponed until further notice.

faq.question: Q4. When will the new PSSSB JE exam date be announced?
faq.answer: The revised examination date has not been specified in the 9 October public notice. The Board will announce it separately on its official website.

faq.question: Q5. Do previously registered candidates need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who already applied under Advertisement No. 07/2026 do not need to submit another application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for PSSSB Junior Engineer?
faq.answer: A three-year Diploma or a higher qualification in the relevant Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering discipline is required, along with other prescribed conditions.

faq.question: Q7. Can B.Tech graduates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification accepts higher qualifications in the same engineering discipline from recognized universities or institutions.

faq.question: Q8. Can I change my category after submitting the form?
faq.answer: No. The advertisement states that the selected category and category code cannot be changed after submission.
